description: This file defines a Java class 'RenderSubContentCacheTransform' which implements a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel to render sub-content with caching considerations. It's used for content rendering in an Apache OFBiz web application, specifically within the content webapp module, and includes logic for fetching, rendering, and editing content blocks within templates.

classes.name: RenderSubContentCacheTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker TemplateTransformModel implementation that renders sub-content with caching and edit capabilities, used within the OFBiz content web application to generate content blocks dynamically in templates.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer object that upon closing, renders sub-content based on the current context, with support for edit mode wrapping.

methods.name: renderSubContent
methods.description: Performs the actual rendering of the content, including optional edit wrap logic.

methods.name: openEditWrap
methods.description: Wraps the content in a div with an edit style for inline editing interface.

methods.name: closeEditWrap
methods.description: Closes the edit wrap by generating an 'Edit' link with proper URL parameters.

methods.name: getEditStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the style class for edit mode, defaulting from properties if not specified.
